plan.title: SRC-BID-001 — Invited vendor opens live RFQ

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ summary as the required first step.
Move to the invited Vendor A supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ from the vendor's event list and enter its pricing round.
Verify the vendor page shows the live RFQ title.
Verify the vendor's product sheet shows the buyer-requested quantity.
Verify the vendor's product sheet shows the buyer-requested unit.
Assert that the terms block is present on the vendor bid page.
Assert that the quotation-template section is rendered.
Assert that the quotation-template download control or label is available.
Verify the vendor can edit Price while the buyer-provided product, quantity, and delivery location remain read-only.
Assert that the vendor can see the quote submission button.
